title: Stress-free family meals
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why can something as simple as a family meal become stressful?
Should parents prepare separate food for children who refuse the main meal?
Is eating together more important than eating a perfectly healthy meal?
How can families reduce conflict about phones, manners, or picky eating at the table?
What family-meal rule would you keep, and what rule would you avoid?
